project_type: Monorepo: FastAPI Python backend, Cloudflare Worker edge proxy (TypeScript), Vite React frontend
build_system: pnpm workspaces for Node, pip for Python. Root: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
build_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build:client
test_command: cd apps/backend && APP_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long-for-ci python -m pytest tests/test_latency_comparison.py -v && cd ../../apps/edge && pnpm test -- tests/latency-comparison.test.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest for the new backend benchmark test. 2. Run vitest for the new edge benchmark test. 3. Verify output shows concrete old-vs-new timing comparisons.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. No Azure/Cloudflare credentials available - benchmarks use mocked I/O with controlled delays to simulate real latency. Python 3.11, Node 22, pnpm available.
contribution_requirements: Tests must be deterministic and pass in CI. Use asyncio for backend timing, performance.now() for edge timing.
key_patterns: Backend: pytest with AsyncMock, patch decorators. Chat uses asyncio.gather for parallel RAG+history. Rate limit uses pipeline+edge trust header. Edge: vitest with vi.fn() mocks. Single unified middleware replaces 3 separate ones. Azure Search warm_up on startup.
directory_structure: apps/backend/tests/ for pytest tests. apps/edge/tests/ for vitest tests. apps/frontend/src/__tests__/ for frontend vitest tests.
